draft.top-ten.body: With pick No. {draftPick}, the {nflTeam} select {school}’s {playerName}. A top-10 selection and a new chapter on football’s biggest professional stage.
TOP 10: {school}’s {playerName} goes No. {draftPick} overall to the {nflTeam}. Round {draftRound}, pick {roundPick}.

draft.pick.body: Round {draftRound}, pick {roundPick} — No. {draftPick} overall. The {nflTeam} select {playerName} from {school}.
The {nflTeam} are on the board with {school}’s {playerName}. Round {draftRound}, pick {roundPick}; No. {draftPick} overall.

draft.irrelevant.body: MR. IRRELEVANT: {school}’s {playerName} goes to the {nflTeam} with the final selection, No. {draftPick}. Last pick. A real opportunity. That closes this year’s draft.

portal.entrant.body: {playerName} is in the transfer portal{originDetail}. One of the names worth tracking as offseason recruiting opens. A portal entry is a starting point, not a new-school announcement.
Portal-opening watch: {playerName} has entered{originDetail}. The next question is fit and opportunity. No commitment to report.

portal.interest.body: Portal watch: {playerName} currently lists {schools} among his leading schools. That is the recruiting picture right now, not a commitment.
The current schools to track for transfer {playerName}: {schools}. This recruitment is still open.

portal.announcement.body: Grateful for everybody who supported me{originDetail}. I’m in the portal and looking forward to finding the right fit for this next chapter.
New chapter ahead. Thankful for the people who have been with me. My recruitment is open and I’m ready to find my next home.

portal.unsigned.body: {starDetail}{playerName} remains uncommitted as offseason recruiting opens. No. {nationalRecruitRank} nationally, with another signing day still ahead. One of the best remaining high school names to track.
Still on the board: {starDetail}{playerName}, No. {nationalRecruitRank} nationally. The transfer portal will get headlines this week; this high school recruitment still matters.

portal.unsigned-schools.body: {playerName} is still uncommitted. His current leading schools include {schools}. There is time left before the next signing day, and this one is worth following.

portal.unsigned-local.body: {starDetail}{playerName} is still uncommitted. No. {nationalRecruitRank} nationally, with offseason recruiting now open and another signing day ahead. A remaining option to track on the high school board.
